body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each may move 1 unit toward cover.
One protected target reduces that Damage by 1 more.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, the first protected target to be missed before your next turn may move 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.
